steps.content: [Scene Transition: Inside the Catastrophe Tear]
The monsters are gone. Emptiness reclaims the space.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Ugh... nngh...
Hypatia clutches her head in pain, trying to pinpoint when the hallucination began. More urgently, if that Rust was an illusion, where is the real one? And where is Margaret?
She staggers, steadies herself, and scans the area. The gray fog has vanished. In its place, dim silhouettes gather, more shadowy figures taking shape before her.
Are they... illusions, or ghosts?
The phantoms emit faint, fragmented whispers, audible only when she draws near.

steps.speaker: Wandering Phantom
steps.content: You really think the elders were right? That we might find Hypercubes here, where the Black Ring passed through?

steps.speaker: Anguished Phantom
steps.content: No... there's nothing... No Hypercubes here. I was wrong. I never should've brought everyone here... Nothing inside but monsters... nothing at all...

steps.speaker: Suffering Phantom
steps.content: It doesn't matter if I die here... but you must... the folks back at camp... they're still waiting...

steps.speaker: Lingering Phantom
steps.content: Search again... keep looking... Perhaps in the next Black Ring... we'll find what we seek...
Hypatia faintly remembers hearing that after the war, many farlanders ventured deep into Mania fields and catastrophe tears across the Whitesands, searching for the lost BR-005 veins.
Others might have dismissed it as a reckless gold rush. But for the farlands, it was a desperate bid for their homeland's very future.
But they lacked the knowledge. They lacked protection. Most invested everything into little more than a dream.

Now their phantoms pass straight through her, a bone-chilling cold that seeps from her soles to her skull. She spins around, but they flow onward, unmindful of her presence, murmuring their regrets to one another as they fade into the gloom.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: This is...?

Perhaps it is her scholar's instinct, but she suddenly realizes these phantoms are all moving with purpose, drifting toward the same destination: the absolute darkness at the catastrophe tear's heart.
Where are they going? What lies in the deepest dark of the tear?
The questions burn in her mind, and she is just about to follow when—
[Flash images: Luminaris Society Director + Undergrounder + Laughter sound effect]
A pain sharper than any she has ever felt lances through her skull, dropping her to her knees.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: What...
The pain is immense—excruciating, radiating from the marrow as if every bone is being charred by infernal fire.

The brand on her neck erupts, surging with frantic growth in this Mania zone. Like a poison vine gorged on nutrients, it spreads and burns, releasing all its long-suppressed power and agony back into her body.
The world flickers madly between black and white, the ghostly figures of the farlanders twisting into blurred distortions. Hypatia clutches her head, a silent scream locked in her throat.
Someone, please... help me...
Mr. Rust, Ms. Margaret, anyone... please... I beg you... help me...
Just as her consciousness teeters on the edge of collapse, a voice—gentle, yet unnervingly chilling—cuts cleanly through the fog of her agony.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Hypatia. So you've found your way here as well. I thought only one Campbell would ever stand in such a place.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: What...
Through the haze of agony, a familiar figure materializes, someone who shouldn't be here. He crouches before her as he did in childhood, his hand reaching out.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Come with me, my dear sister. We have been bound by blood since birth. We have always been together... and so we shall remain. Isn't that true?

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: You know I have always needed you, just as you need me. Even if the world turns its back on us... by the Golden Rose, I will remain at your side. Is that not what you've always wished for?
...Brother?
The agony is overwhelming, and the buried, childish longing for family affection nearly swallows her whole.
Her hand moves on its own, reaching for Adelaide. But just before her fingertips brush his, a shock of cold reason tears through her mind.
Wait. What are you doing, Hypatia?
Have you really fallen this far? To actually consider seeking guidance from Adelaide?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: No... you're not...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: You're not my brother!!
At her near-frenzied shout, a streak of white light shoots from beside her and slams into the phantom.

It's Margaret's dove. The bird beats its wings with fierce fury, striking Adelaide's form like a raptor defending its nest, each impact sharp enough to pierce. Under the relentless assault, the phantom shudders, then dissolves into splintering light, fracturing like a shattered mirror.
